name: openpixo/sfx-and-music-integration
title: SFX and music integration
description: Wire existing game audio with voice limits, variation, separate mix preferences, music ducking, clean loops and browser unlock handling.

description_i18n.en: Wire existing game audio with voice limits, variation, separate mix preferences, music ducking, clean loops and browser unlock handling.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 接入已有游戏音频，处理声部上限、音色变化、独立混音偏好、音乐闪避、循环接缝与浏览器解锁。

examples.title: Improve the platformer's sound effects

title_i18n.zh-CN: 改进平台跳跃游戏的音效

examples.prompt: Reuse the Phaser sample platformer's jump.wav and coin.wav. Add bounded jump pitch variation, an SFX volume control that survives scene restarts, and a voice limit for rapid pickups; verify the build and test browser audio unlock.

prompt_i18n.zh-CN: 复用 Phaser 平台跳跃示例的 jump.wav 和 coin.wav，加入有限的跳跃音高变化、场景重启后保留的音效音量控制，以及快速拾取时的声部上限；验证构建并测试浏览器音频解锁。

examples.title: Duck Godot music under effects

title_i18n.zh-CN: 让 Godot 音乐为音效闪避

examples.prompt: Route this Godot project's existing music and effects through Music and SFX buses. Add gentle SFX-sidechain music ducking, keep saved volume and mute independent, then verify and listen through overlapping effects and pause/resume.

prompt_i18n.zh-CN: 将这个 Godot 项目已有的音乐和音效路由到 Music 与 SFX 总线，加入温和的 SFX 侧链音乐闪避，保持已保存的音量与静音独立，然后验证并试听音效叠加和暂停恢复。

examples.title: Repair an ambience loop
examples.prompt: Inspect the selected ambience recording, make a new loop-ready copy with a 60ms crossfade using pixo asset audio loop, preserve the original, enable looping in the current engine, and listen across two loop boundaries before reporting the result.

prompt_i18n.zh-CN: 检查选中的环境音录音，用 pixo asset audio loop 制作带 60 毫秒交叉淡化的循环副本，保留原文件，在当前引擎启用循环，并在试听两个循环接点后报告结果。
